limb_scale_contract.real_fit_rule: Before real fitting, convert raw surface observations into a frozen, provenance-preserving scale likelihood or bounded proxy using an explicit landmark-to-joint-center mapping and nonzero uncertainty. Real IMU residuals may not freely change absolute link length to improve fit.
limb_scale_contract.if_internal_mapping_remains_unqualified: Use one preregistered LANDMARK_PROXY skeleton consistently for A/B/C and label it non-anatomical; do not claim anatomical-geometry PASS, while heading/basis diagnostics may continue.

legacy_parameter_disposition.reuse_rule: No old numerical value may enter the replacement real fit merely because it exists in config_v1.json or source. Reuse requires an entry in the new active registry with independent provenance and pre-real-fit qualification.

runtime_active_parameter_registry.post_fit_changes: append-only new run and reseal; no in-place threshold or geometry edits

threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.sensor_noise_parameters: estimated from initial still with correlation and quantization, plus preregistered scale/cross-axis/drift/timing sensitivity; recorded per node
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.human_model_error: soft tissue, slow strap slippage, nonideal hinge/center migration, asymmetry and imperfect movement widen covariance or robust loss; never exact-equality stop or per-action profile
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.scientific_thresholds: fixed before real fitting from covariance/probability/physical manifold/independent synthetic and sensitivity-tested
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.solver_tolerances_and_iteration_limits: listed in active registry and convergence traces; numerical settings are not scientific truth
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.viewer_dimensions: come from this geometry contract or are explicitly labeled proxies; never hidden constants
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.ordinary_warning_or_low_information: Class C or D and does not terminate the overall task
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.physical_impossibility: Class B candidate rejection before residual ranking
threshold_and_numerical_parameter_rule.architecture_or_provenance_violation: Class A current-run stop, repair, reseal, and continue overall task
